Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take the cauldron while holding two other items, ignoring the strict "max two objects" inventory limit. I also failed to realize that the cauldron is a fixed object in the room (not an item to be taken) and that I needed to use the "plate" as a temporary holder to swap items in and out of my inventory. My strategy should have been: 1) Immediately take the plate upon entering the kitchen. 2) Use the plate to hold one ingredient while retrieving the second ingredient. 3) Once I have both ingredients and the plate, use the plate to drop one ingredient into the cauldron, then drop the plate to free up a slot for the second ingredient. 4) Finally, use the fire wand to activate the cauldron. I must stop trying to "take" the cauldron and instead focus on managing my inventory slots using the plate as a buffer.
